==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|clowdy||EME}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|cloudy|t=cloudy, overcast, gloomy, dark", also "hilly, rocky}}, from {{inh|en|ang|clūdiġ|t=stony, rocky}}, equivalent to {{suf|en|cloud|y|id2=adjectival}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈklaʊ̯diː/|[ˈkʰlaʊ̯dɪi̯]|a=RP,GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-cloudy.ogg|a=US}}
*** {{IPA|en|[ˈklaʊ̯ɾiː]|[ˈkʰlaʊ̯ɾɪi̯]|a=t-flapping}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈklæʊ̯diː/|[ˈkʰlaʊ̯dɪi̯]|a=Southern US,Midland US,Mid-Atlantic US,NYC,AU,NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈklaːdiː/|[ˈkʰlaːdɪi̯]|a=Pittsburgh,ZA,[[w:Monophthongization|/aʊ̯/-monophthongization]]}}
* {{rhymes|en|aʊdi|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|clou|dy}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|er}}

# Covered with or characterised by [[cloud]]s.
#: {{syn|en|clouded|overcast}}
#: {{ant|en|cloudless|noncloudy|unclouded|uncloudy}}
# Not [[transparent]] or clear.
#* {{RQ:Time|title=Best Inventions of 2002|year=2002
|passage={{...}} aerogel resembles smoke that has been frozen into place — it's '''cloudy''', translucent and virtually weightless.
|url=http://content.time.com/time/specials/packages/article/0,28804,1934259_1934610_1934602,00.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260113194541/https://content.time.com/time/specials/packages/article/0,28804,1934259_1934610_1934602,00.html|archivedate=13 January 2026}}
## {{lb|en|of fruit juice}} Containing [[pith]]
# Uncertain; [[unclear]].
# {{lb|en|computing|informal}} Using or relating to [[cloud computing]].
#: {{ux|en|a '''cloudy''' infrastructure}}
# {{lb|en|slang|archaic}} [[shady]]; [[sketchy]]; [[suspicious]]
# Having cloudlike markings.
#: {{ux|en|'''cloudy''' marble}}
